'''Insurers'''<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> or '''insurance salesmen'''<ref name="GA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref> were individuals who sold insurance. Adding anti-theft devices to [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] could lead to insurers giving discounts on theft insurance.<ref name="GFT" /> The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Kapin Toologin]] was an insurance salesman who vacationed on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="GA" />
